description:
Join us for a heartwarming kids read-aloud of Lost and Found by *Oliver Jeffers! This beloved picture book tells the sweet story of a little boy who finds a penguin at his door — and sets off on an unforgettable adventure to help him find his way home. 🌊❤️

This touching tale about friendship, kindness, bravery, and helping others is perfect for preschoolers, kindergarteners, and early readers. Children will love the gentle message and beautiful illustrations in this classic storytime favorite.

Perfect for:
✨ Classroom storytime
✨ Bedtime reading
✨ SEL (social-emotional learning)
✨ Friendship-themed lessons

🎧 Watch, listen, and read along as we bring this charming adventure to life!
📚 Don’t forget to like 👍, subscribe 🔔, and share for more read-aloud stories every week!
